import os, subprocess, ctypes, torch, statistics, time
from b200probe import harness_time
SRC=open('/tmp/r6/src.txt').read() if os.path.exists('/tmp/r6/src.txt') else None
print('src kept', SRC is not None)
if SRC is None: raise SystemExit
# variants: NOFENCE removes the proxy fence; LATE issues prefetch loads after the arrive
S=SRC.replace('asm volatile("fence.proxy.async.shared::cta;" ::: "memory");','\n#ifndef NOFENCE\n asm volatile("fence.proxy.async.shared::cta;" ::: "memory");\n#endif\n')
S=S.replace('        if (kb + kPF < kKB) load_kb(buf[(u + kPF) % kNBuf], src, kb + kPF, pol);\n','#ifndef LATE\n        if (kb + kPF < kKB) load_kb(buf[(u + kPF) % kNBuf], src, kb + kPF, pol);\n#endif\n')
S=S.replace('        if (lane == 0) arrive_cluster(fullL + 8 * s);\n','        if (lane == 0) arrive_cluster(fullL + 8 * s);\n#ifdef LATE\n        if (kb + kPF < kKB) load_kb(buf[(u + kPF) % kNBuf], src, kb + kPF, pol);\n#endif\n')
assert S.count('NOFENCE')==1 and S.count('LATE')==2
open('/tmp/r6/v.cu','w').write(S)
variants={'base':'','nofence':'-DNOFENCE','late':'-DLATE','late_p3':'-DLATE -DTCH_PF=3'}
ps={n:subprocess.Popen(f'nvcc -O3 --use_fast_math -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC {f} -o /tmp/r6/v_{n}.so /tmp/r6/v.cu -lcuda',shell=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True) for n,f in variants.items()}
for n,p in ps.items():
    o,e=p.communicate(); print(n,p.returncode,e[-300:] if p.returncode else '')
libs={n:ctypes.CDLL(f'/tmp/r6/v_{n}.so') for n in variants}
prof=torch.zeros(144*4,dtype=torch.int64,device='cuda')
st=torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream
def mk(lib,B):
    e16=torch.empty(B,3072,dtype=torch.half,device='cuda')
    def fn(emb,W,bias,*outs):
        arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
        r=lib.adamod_tc_h(ctypes.c_void_p(emb.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_void_p(W.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_void_p(bias.data_ptr()),arr,ctypes.c_void_p(e16.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_int(B),ctypes.c_void_p(st))
        assert r==0,r
    return fn
torch.manual_seed(0)
W=torch.randn(18432,3072,device='cuda')/3072**0.5
bias=torch.randn(18432,device='cuda')
for B in [384,512,919]:
    emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device='cuda')
    outs=[torch.empty(B,3072,device='cuda') for _ in range(6)]
    ref=(emb.double()@W.double().T+bias.double())
    res=[]
    for n,lib in libs.items():
        fn=mk(lib,B)
        lib.set_prof(ctypes.c_void_p(0))
        us=harness_time(fn,(emb,W,bias),tuple(outs))
        lib.set_prof(ctypes.c_void_p(prof.data_ptr())); prof.zero_(); fn(emb,W,bias,*outs); torch.cuda.synchronize(); lib.set_prof(ctypes.c_void_p(0))
        pr=prof.view(-1,4)[:72*(1 if B<=512 else 2)].cpu().double()
        err=(torch.cat(outs,1).double()-ref).abs().max().item()
        mhz=1e3/statistics.median((pr[:,3]/2**20).tolist())
        res.append(f"{n}:{us:.1f}us kb={statistics.median(pr[:,1].tolist())/48:.0f} {mhz:.0f}MHz err={err:.2e}")
    print(B,' | '.join(res))
